name: therapy session notes
content_styles: Write like a therapist's session notes about the topic. A client name, a presenting problem, session observations, and a treatment plan. Voice is clinical, empathetic, and absurdly serious about nonsense.
Write like a couples counseling intake form. A couple, a 'presenting issue', each partner's account, and a 'goals' section. Voice is professional and slightly exhausted.
Write like a support group transcript. A facilitator, members, shares, and a closing. Voice is warm, earnest, and increasingly unhinged.
layouts: Build session notes: a header with client name and date, a presenting problem, session observations, a treatment plan, and a signature. Single column, clinical form.
Build an intake form: a header, a 'presenting issue', each partner's account, and a 'goals' section. Single column, form layout.
Build a support group transcript: a header, a facilitator intro, member shares, and a closing. One continuous transcript.
themes: Clinical look: white background, black text, a muted accent, and a clean sans-serif. Unified and professional.
Intake look: white background, gray form fields, a single accent, and a formal sans-serif. Unified and bureaucratic.
Support group look: warm background, soft accents, a friendly sans-serif, and a comforting feel. Unified and warm.
visual_style: VISUAL: clinical intake. White background, black text, a muted accent, bordered form sections, a signature line, and a professional feel.
